svg.title: LongMemEval-S recall@1, n=500, in two store conditions
svg.desc: Two panels. Condition A, per-instance scoped haystacks: Titen 0.6.0 FTS+vector 0.900, Titen 0.6.0 FTS-only 0.880, verbatim-RAG router control 0.854, MemPalace 3.6.0 0.804 — only one pairing in this panel is significant, and the vector arm is not proven. Condition B, all 19,829 sessions pooled into one store: Titen 0.7.0 FTS-only 0.246, Titen 0.7.0 FTS+vector 0.212, Mem0 2.0.15 infer=False 0.182, verbatim-RAG router control 0.174, MemPalace 3.6.0 0.164, verbatim-RAG fastembed control 0.124 — these separations are significant. Two of Titen's pre-registered falsifiers fired producing this chart.
svg.text: LONGMEMEVAL-S · RECALL@1 · N=500 · OUR SCORER · FAILURES IN THE DENOMINATOR
One corpus, two store conditions — and the condition moves recall@1 by 63 points.
CONDITION A · PER-INSTANCE (SCOPED) · ~50-SESSION HAYSTACK PER QUESTION · titen-memory 0.6.0
Axis truncated at 0.75 — at full scale these four bars are visually one bar, which is the finding. recall@10 here is 0.982 and saturated.
CONDITION B · POOLED · ALL 19,829 SESSIONS IN ONE STORE · SAME 500 QUESTIONS · titen-memory 0.7.0
Axis runs from zero and tops out at 0.30. Every bar in this panel would fall off the left edge of panel A's axis — the two panels do not share a scale.

g.text: Panel A, all three paired sign tests at k=1: FTS+vector vs FTS-only 27 W / 17 L / 456 T, p = 0.174 — the vector arm is unproven. FTS-only vs the router control 44/31/425, p = 0.165 — not significant.
FTS+vector vs that same control 35/12/453, p = 0.0011 — the one significant separation in this panel, and it does not establish the vector arm as its cause.

Panel B, pooled: Titen FTS-only vs the fastembed control 86 W / 25 L / 389 T, p < 0.0001; vs MemPalace 76/35/389, p = 0.0001 — the first significant lane-vs-lane separations this programme has produced.
The vector arm reverses between the panels. +2.0 points per-instance (unproven, p = 0.174) and −3.4 pooled (0.212 vs 0.246, p = 0.082). Three embedding families land 7.2–16.8 below FTS-only.

Two of Titen's own pre-registered falsifiers fired producing panel B: the scale axis exists (FTS-only 0.880 → 0.246, −63.4 points) and compile p95 is 864.9 ms against a pre-registered 250 ms kill line.
Retrieval significance does not transfer to answers. Answer accuracy is a flat null: eight pre-registered comparisons against the dense control, none significant, best p = 0.41.

svg.text: SOURCES · docs/testing/EVALS.md (panel A, 2026-08-04/06) · docs/testing/2026-08-07-pooled-store.md (panel B) · docs/testing/2026-08-08-pooled-improvements.md (re-verified, no headline changes)
